publicReleaseNotes: Penny 0.2.1 restores backups into an installation whose database RER Platform migrated. rer import and rer export ran Wrangler's migrations on every local transfer; Wrangler cannot read Platform's rer_migrations ledger, re-applied every migration and stopped with "table operators already exists" before any data moved. A local transfer now reads the migration ledger first: on a Platform-migrated database it leaves migrations to Platform's runner, runs no Wrangler migration and refuses before writing (migration_ledger:unapplied or migration_ledger:multiple) unless every migration of this version is already applied; other databases are migrated by Wrangler as before. A backup made by an earlier Penny and a backup made by this version both restore with every archived row, cell and original file exact into Platform-migrated and native installations. No migrations; it runs on rer 0.2.77. Local setup and dev on a Platform-migrated database, SendGrid duplicate suppression, live external feedback providers and whole-product acceptance beyond the proved core loop remain known limits. Product screenshot: public/brand/releases/penny-0.2.0-1440.png
agentUpdateInstructions: Update from v0.2.0 with git pull and rer install (hosted: rer deploy), preserving the owner, private settings, every product row, original file and the existing migration ledger; this release adds no migration and changes no schema. Use the exact rer 0.2.77 pin; the recorded Base copies stay at 91c082876d6560150f3dc012ec57b92bd9895228. A local rer export or rer import on a database RER Platform migrated (its rer_migrations ledger) runs no Wrangler migration and requires every migration file of this version in that ledger by SHA-256; otherwise it refuses with migration_ledger:unapplied:<file>, or migration_ledger:multiple:rer_migrations beside a Wrangler ledger, before writing. Apply pending migrations through Platform first; never edit a migration ledger or add a Wrangler ledger beside Platform's to get past a refusal. Restore into an empty destination with its paired latest erasure journal, before setup, and supply fresh owner and provider configuration afterwards; every archived row and original object must survive. Local rer setup and rer dev still migrate with Wrangler and are not supported on a Platform-migrated database. SendGrid delivery keys remain correlation only, with ambiguous sends held; live external providers and whole-product acceptance retain the limits in ACCEPTANCE.md and HANDOVER.md.
